summary:
Completed Professional Design & Structure Overhaul of Git Manager Studio:
- Normalized design tokens, font hierarchy, and tabular figures in index.css
- Enforced strict 3-Zone Desktop header contract (contextual breadcrumbs, Command Palette trigger, live sync indicator, actions)
- Upgraded Desktop Dashboard with disciplined 4-column KPI strip (Repositories, Total Stars, Recorded Commits, Pull Requests), modern velocity AreaChart, and dual-column bottom split (Recent Workspaces + Live Activity Feed)
- Replaced instructional boilerplate in Repositories Explorer with a high-density Developer Instrument Console featuring HTTPS/SSH clone switcher with 1-click copy, language breakdown progress bar, and immediate workspace actions
- Verified with 100% clean linting and compilation.
